positive: Find who calls or imports a module and its blast radius before editing it, using the local dependency graph instead of opening every module by hand
Check which tests must be retested for a set of changed paths using the saved dependency graph

Investigate why one specific test is failing

behavior_assertions.assert: atlas graph declares exactly the rebuild, query, and verify subcommands the flow names.
the skill's own bundle (frontmatter, PURPOSE.md cite, routing rows, this file) validates structurally.

behavior_assertions: atlas graph verify rebuilds fresh in memory and reports whether the saved snapshot still matches, without overwriting it - proven in tests/test_godmode_codegraph.py's stale/no-snapshot cases, not run here since it needs an initialized archive.
atlas graph rebuild derives a fresh graph from the archive and overwrites the saved snapshot, deterministically - proven in tests/test_godmode_codegraph.py, not run here for the same reason.
atlas closure names every dependent of a changed file that was not itself changed, before a blast-radius edit.
A query for a node the graph has never seen refuses with unknown_node rather than guessing.
